title: The Listening Walk
description: For ages 6–9 with an adult: walk very quietly and collect all the sounds you can hear along the way.

body.heading: Walk and listen
paragraphs: Walk slowly with your adult. Every few steps, stop, close your eyes, and listen hard.
Birds, leaves, footsteps, a distant dog: count how many sounds you can catch.

body.heading: Draw your sounds
paragraphs: When you get home, draw the things that made your favourite sounds.
Sounds leave no footprints, so your drawing is the only way to keep them.

takeaway: When you listen on purpose, the world is much louder than you thought.
materials: Paper and a pencil for afterwards
safetyNotes: Walk with your adult, hold hands near roads, and stop only in safe places to listen.
screenFreeExtension: Do a listening sit at home: one quiet minute, then list every sound you heard.
